actions.name: Devolution
actions.flavor: "It's deeper, deeper than anyone has ever gone. It's lying below the gargling soup in a place no mind can comprehend. Each of us—even the Beast—are all legions of warring paramecia. All we seek is the peace waiting for us in darkness. Like the good old days."
body: Draw a circle roughly 2 Speed in diameter, incorporating at least one location controlled by this faction. Place the Devolve map hazard in this space.

subs.name: Devolve Map Hazard
body: A unique map hazard. The land around this space begins to return to a Carboniferous-era geography, with thick, impassable forests and incredibly active tectonic plate activity. For each STRATCOM turn this hazard is present, advance along the track below, activating the effects of each stage in turn. Clearing the hazard immediately ends all effects.
Stage 1 - The ground becomes soft, and strange growth begins to block passage. Once, during any TACCOM at this location, at any time during the GMs turn, place up to 10 Obstacle or Uneasy tiles.

Stage 2 - Beasts of a forgotten age rise from the cracks in the earth, and undergrowth make movement perilous. In addition to the effects from Stage 1, all Spawner tagged creatures gain 1 Speed, and gain an additional Charge per turn.

Stage 3 - All light is blotted out, and all sound is deadened by the unstoppable growth of the putrid forest. The faces of your friends and family mark the wood. Select a location close to this one and mark it. It has all the effects of Stage 1.

actions.name: Soulwounding World Realignment
actions.flavor: They will build a knife of the past and thrust it into the heart of the universe. They will tear the future from a blooded ribcage and replace it with a broken clock. The pathlines of destiny rearranged into an inescapable loop; trapped forever in a miserable uroboros of broken fate.
body: Crown: ΘΘΘ Choose two locations. Create a hydrothermal sea between them. Passing this requires some form of transport, and should be considered a highly risky environment even then, reducing Speed by half and making the team a target for the Syncrasian fleet. The sea clears up after the next STRATCOM turn.

actions.name: Fungal Eruption
actions.flavor: Dynasties are not built without foundation in the worlds of men, and beasts, and demons. Sweet spore clouds whisper to Aamon’s children, painting for them the vast spoils of conquest if only they submit. Become a beast for your king, build his dynasty, and it could be yours in turn.
body: Crown:ΘΘΘ Tenders of fungal nodes cultivate and agitate them into a Hell-wide blooming of spores. In the next TACCOM encounter, all unit powers which trigger commanding of other HENOSIS units or portions of a Swarm have their damage or Speed increased by one as chosen by the GM at the time of the action.

actions.name: Veil Bombardment
body: REQUIRED: Night’s Veil Location Unlocked. Shade passed over the fields on the hottest day of the season and Kenri the yeoman sighed in relief. He looked at the pastures below, regarding all he cared for and all which cared for him. Sweat prickled at the back of his neck as new heat bloomed in the shade. Deathcaps blossomed at his feet as the shadows wisped away into the air. He turned his gaze upward, seeing now two suns cresting to highest noon. Surely it was an illusion, that he had ever been the custodian of anything. HENOSIS forces call in an airstrike using the Night’s Veil. During your next TACCOM Engagement you may deploy up to 3 Blast:3, Damage 4 explosions over the course of the engagement.

actions.name: Scratch Them Out
body: (Required: Crooked Obelisk Location) The Crooked Obelisk fires a focused and condensed beam of hungry nothing that grants oblivion to all those unlucky enough to be in its path. Death is not the end. The void is. During your next TACCOM Engagement, at the beginning of Turn 1 draw a straight line either horizontally or vertically across the entirety of the play space. At the start of the next turn (Turn 2), do 15 damage to anything inside that line. The Obelisk must spend the next turn charging, but can be used again starting on Turn 4, repeating the cycle of Aim Line, Fire, Charge until the battle is over.

actions.name: Wireweal Outbreak
body: (Required: Carcinogenic Defensive Upgrade) Though primitive, the wireweals demonstrate a kind of intelligence not unlike a pack animal. Through a mix of droning sirens and Pavlovian behavioral conditioning, even the hylic manifestation of the land’s hollow soul can be used as a weapon.

Crown:ΘΘΘ Temporarily enclose a location in clusters of Rust Palisade Fortifications. Attacking this Location any time this turn or the next will cause 5 Blob:5 clusters of Wireweal to be added to the defenses, placed in areas either protecting AUTO- PHYES interests or in ways to inconvenience the players. On turn 2 and every 2nd turn after that, add another Blob:5 cluster.

actions.name: Awakened World-Choking Python
actions.flavor: "Our ascension carried us, and our fortress, through the twisted body of the idiot god. Your kind bathed in his blood to reclaim your fire, but it was us that first bled him, stained the waters he languished in. We irrigated the cista mystica with his irreverent hemocyanin, and from this coffin will rise a devourer of sacred fruits."
body: Crown:ΘΘΘ Spend 3 Ichor plus ichor equal to the number of Python’s spawned this campaign and place a massive egg within Speed: 1 of any location this faction currently holds. At the start of the following STRATCOM, spawn The World-Choking Python from the egg. The snake represents a moving location with the following stats: Purpose: Annihilation, Agnosis Through Devouring. Terrain: Scales and bronze-age armor, slime and venom and a constantly shifting surface. Endless dust storms. Defenses: Endless troops, six Agean seals, defensive regalia, teeth and mass. Quality: 2 Force, 2 Territory Special: TACCOM occurring at this location has the following conditions: All Spawner tagged units gain an additional Charge during combat. All Miniboss and Boss tagged units gain Snakeskin. Units with Snakeskin take 0 damage from any attack targeting them, then lose Snakeskin. During STRATCOM, the GM may move the snake Speed:1. If the snake collides with players, immediately move to RECON. If the snake collides with a location, it temporarily devours it, placing the location inside the snake and granting that location the same buffs as the Python. Assaulting the python and succeeding destroys the Python, removing it from the STRATCOM map and play. Only one python or its egg can be in play at any one time.

actions.name: Ephemeral Serpent Deception
actions.flavor: They are not lying. They are not liars. This implies they know the truth and speak against it—it's more accurate to say they carry a lie with them, a falsehood infesting their nous that spills out around them. The new truth sticks like earthblood, tarring reality forever with some aspect of the revision.
body: Select a unit or location and remove it from the STRATCOM map. Write its new location in your War Journal, then reveal it at the start of the following STRATCOM phase.

actions.name: Run of Blood
actions.flavor: A routine terraforming technique developed by CAIM himself, Metricosian Sages can compel a powerful river of blood from even a simple gash in the worldflesh.
body: Draw a line Map Speed: 1 long. A river of blood cuts through and erodes it into a deep and treacherous ravine. During TACCOM, reveal 1 Leech Mire at any time.

actions.name: Descend the Vultures
actions.flavor: Vultures among the Metricos are hungry things capable of devouring nearly anything. Large flying beasts that stay aloft in spite of their bloodsoaked feathers, their trainers are in as much danger as their enemies.
body: Send a committee of bloodwinged vultures to a location of your choosing. No other STRATCOM or RECON actions may occur there until the vultures are driven out.

actions.name: Rising Echo
actions.flavor: The secrets of blood are broken and twisted to imprint the likeness, skills, and arsenal of a defeated HELLPIERCER into a sageblood homunculus. This creature emerges from the Pit to do the vengeful bidding of CAIM.
body: Create a demonic clone of a defeated HELLPIERCER at a PIT OF KESTE- RION. Only one clone can be alive at a time.

actions.name: Scour of Babel
actions.flavor: An exertion from the Source Seed will send a wave through the entire Contagion Mind, concentrating into an eye at a place of their choosing. So long as vision is maintained, Paraclesal pollen will saturate the surrounding area to reflect what some believe the true home of the Paracletus looks like.
body: Choose a location on the map—you may increase its Eyerot stage by 1. HELLPIERCERS may clear Eyerot with salted weapons.

Stage 1: A rotting eye grows somewhere in the shadows. Visitors will hear echoes of sounds that never happened, lights and shapes will tempt from just out of sight. Paracletus Demons can disguise themselves as humans.

Stage 2: The eyerot here gains a weirding shield and another Eyerot grows on a connected location. Your speech turns to water, your writing turns to spirals, your signing turns to strangulation. Stain blooms on the ground and dusts the air. A strange song churns in your gut. The shielding can be dispelled by smearing roe on its surface.
Stage 3: Visitors' flesh turn to tangled colors and light. Corners and doorways take you to unknown places. Encounters here start with the entire map Stained.

actions.name: Seideonic Call
actions.flavor: The swirling ooze from the Seed dissolving into the water creates a new weapon—a dense and pulsating cloud drifting through the skies. It will lay claim on any land it shadows.
body: Condense a cloud on any Paracletus controlled location. It has a Speed of 1 and rains stain across any location it inhabits. A location can only have one cloud above it at a time. When you enter TACCOM on a location with a cloud, you may do the following at the beginning of your turn: choose five squares— those squares are Stained until the beginning of your next turn.

actions.name: Millenium Storm
actions.flavor: To build and sustain the storm, each chanter must not only speak out, but experience in fullness the truth of each canticle. As they shrink and shiver, their lips implacably move. Their voices echo still as they are torn asunder and forged by cold wind into daggers of ice meant for the hearts of the obscene.
body: Vents of near-absolute cold are torn open by THELETUS operatives nearby the HELLPIERCER vanguard. An epoch-defining storm is unleashed in the area, bringing with it lethal cold, complete whiteout conditions, and the icing of all surfaces in its path. HELLPIERCER movement time for their next STRATCOM action is doubled.

actions.name: The Perfected Scream
actions.flavor: The music theoreticians of DIS cannot account for Theletus’s invention of what has been described as the White Note. Capable at once of freezing in place all opposition and shoring the defenses of Theletus fighters, the White Note cannot currently be replicated by any means accessible to Ascended Humanity.
body: (REQUIRED: The Clangorous Abbey and The Railing Grounds Locations Unlocked.) The works of the scientist-monks of The Clangorous Abbey and the Ecstatic Warriors of the Railing Grounds bear their ultimate fruit. In the next TAC- COM encounter, one time THELETUS forces may call in the transcendent shout which sustains THELEUS and dismantles their enemies. All THELETUS units gain Fortified: 1 and all opposing units gain Frozen: 2. Units frozen this way can be Shattered twice before losing the Frozen effect.
